description: Read Wiro playbooks: short guides with the order of calls, the formats and the money rules for one kind of job. Read the relevant topic before a multi-step job, such as building or running a workflow, deploying or setting up an agent, or a Studio session, and follow it. Each topic is enough for its own job; read getting-started when the route or the workspace is unclear. Topics: getting-started (which route fits a request, what costs money, keys and workspaces, errors, long waits, the money rules); models (finding and comparing models, schemas and file fields, running, batches, waiting and stopping, prices and limits, earlier tasks, LLM chats); workflows (finding and running workflows, costs, breakpoints, failed runs, editing, cloning, deleting); workflow-graph (the graph create_workflow and update_workflow take: steps, Start fields, references, utilities, examples); workflow-agent (briefing the agent, editing a workflow by chat, pricing and saving its proposals, sessions); studio (when to use Studio, what a turn costs, the brief, collecting the results, slow turns); agents (templates and plans, deploying, statuses, setup and sign-ins, an agent that does not answer, messages, plan changes and credits, skills and schedules, removal); billing (which wallet pays, what is charged and when, minimums and limits, teams, estimates, where to see past spending). Several topics can be read in one call.

topics.description: One or more playbook topics to read, e.g. ["workflows"] or ["agents", "billing"].

name: get_playbook
title: Read a Wiro playbook
